Expo development/build certificate tooling only in the current graph; no application imports or OTA code-signing configuration. Signature-verification tooling remains affected; no patched release is published. Remove on a patched compatible release (#1996).

@expo/cli requires zod 3.x, so the patched 4.x line cannot be adopted yet. App runtime use is limited to parseContract validation of first-party QueenZone /api/v1 responses over HTTPS (constrained arrays capped at 225); an attacker would need to control the trusted API or TLS. Expo CLI uses it on local build config. Remove when Expo moves to a patched zod.
